description: This file implements the StateObserver class, which manages session server states, including tracking state changes, retrieving current states, and identifying the active application within the rialto::servermanager namespace.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A class that observes and manages the state of session servers, providing methods to update and query server states.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Updates the state of a session server identified by appId.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the session server for the given appId.

methods.name: getActiveApp
methods.description: Returns the appId of the currently active session server, or an empty string if none is active.
